panels.title: Guard events per user and verdict

targets.rawSql: SELECT User AS user, Verdict AS verdict, count() AS events FROM guard.guard_events WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'bmad-guard' GROUP BY user, verdict ORDER BY user, verdict

SELECT LogAttributes['reason_code'] AS rule_id, Guard AS guard, count() AS blocks, uniqExact(User) AS users FROM guard.guard_events WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'bmad-guard' AND Verdict = 'block' GROUP BY rule_id, guard ORDER BY blocks DESC

SELECT LogAttributes['reason_code'] AS rule_id, Guard AS guard, count() AS warnings, uniqExact(User) AS users FROM guard.guard_events WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName = 'bmad-guard' AND Verdict = 'warn' GROUP BY rule_id, guard ORDER BY warnings DESC

panels.title: Claude Code events by name (name is in Body, not EventName)

targets.rawSql: SELECT Body AS event, User AS user, count() AS events FROM guard.guard_events WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ServiceName != 'bmad-guard' GROUP BY event, user ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT Attributes['user'] AS user, sum(Value) AS sessions FROM guard.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'claude-code' AND MetricName = 'claude_code.session.count' GROUP BY user ORDER BY sessions DESC

panels.title: Claude Code tokens per user and type

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['user'] AS user, Attributes['type'] AS type, sum(Value) AS tokens FROM guard.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'claude-code' AND MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage' GROUP BY user, type ORDER BY user, type

panels.title: Claude Code cost (USD) per user and model

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['user'] AS user, Attributes['model'] AS model, round(sum(Value), 4) AS cost_usd FROM guard.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'claude-code' AND MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' GROUP BY user, model ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Claude Code lines of code per user

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['user'] AS user, Attributes['type'] AS type, sum(Value) AS lines FROM guard.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'claude-code' AND MetricName = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' GROUP BY user, type ORDER BY user, type

panels.title: Claude Code commits and pull requests per user

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['user'] AS user, replaceOne(MetricName, 'claude_code.', '') AS metric, sum(Value) AS total FROM guard.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'claude-code' AND MetricName IN ('claude_code.commit.count', 'claude_code.pull_request.count') GROUP BY user, metric ORDER BY user, metric

panels.title: Claude Code edit tool decisions per user

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['user'] AS user, Attributes['tool_name'] AS tool, Attributes['decision'] AS decision, sum(Value) AS decisions FROM guard.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'claude-code' AND MetricName = 'claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision' GROUP BY user, tool, decision ORDER BY user, tool, decision

panels.title: Claude Code active time (s) per user

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['user'] AS user, Attributes['type'] AS type, round(sum(Value), 1) AS seconds FROM guard.otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'claude-code' AND MetricName = 'claude_code.active_time.total' GROUP BY user, type ORDER BY user, type
